rationale: Both Wing Chuen and Balakumar work in robotics manipulation—Wing Chuen as a Mechatronic Engineer building hardware systems at The Robot Works, and Balakumar as a Research Scientist at NVIDIA focusing on manipulation and perception. Balakumar's depth in motion planning, ROS, and robotic perception (LiDAR, force sensing) complements Wing Chuen's hands-on systems integration background, making them natural collaborators for discussing the bridge between research algorithms and physical robot implementation.
intro_message: Wing Chuen Lam, meet Balakumar Sundaralingam—you both work in robotics manipulation and could swap notes on the hardware-to-software integration challenges you each see from different sides of the industry.
